name: Lupian
source:
"I was born with the same destiny as you. No matter the time I'm your ally."

A mysterious prince that appeared when Thumbelina was in a pinch.
He fights using the sword on his hip and flower magic.
It seems since his birth he's held an important secret concerning Thumbelina...?
